steps.label: Describe
steps.title: Say who you want
steps.body: Type it plain: "Head of Sales at fintech companies in Jakarta, 11 to 50 people." Filters fill in from your words.

steps.label: Filter
steps.title: Only filters the data can honor
steps.body: Title, seniority, function, person location, industry, company size. No intent, no lookalikes, no technologies. If we cannot filter it, we do not show the filter.

steps.label: Results
steps.title: Search is free
steps.body: Rows come from our verified cache first, then a live fetch for the shortfall. You see the real count: "52 in cache · fetching more". No inflated match numbers.

steps.label: Reveal
steps.title: Reveal (1 credit)
steps.body: Each email is verified before it is charged. Unverified rows stay visible and exportable without email, never billed.

steps.label: Export
steps.title: Export CSV
steps.body: Paste into Instantly, Lemlist, or HubSpot. A revealed lead is yours forever; revealing it again costs nothing.

cards.title: Verified before you pay
cards.body: We check the email before the credit leaves your balance. If it bounces later, the credit comes back automatically.

cards.title: No subscription. No seats. No expiry.
cards.body: $5 buys 100 credits, one-time. They sit in your account until you use them. No monthly plan required, no per-seat tax for your team.

cards.title: Owned forever
cards.body: A revealed lead never costs again. Search it next month, next year; it is still yours at zero credits.

items.title: Source

items.title: Coverage
items.body: EU and UK contacts are excluded. We only serve regions where we can meet our data obligations today.

items.title: Retention
items.body: Personal fields are purged 12 months after collection. Cached leads older than 90 days are re-checked before reveal.
